lines.say: switches on GLP-1 receptors: more insulin, less glucagon when blood sugar is high
about 15% less body weight in 68 weeks, versus 2% on placebo; most returns after stopping
fewer heart attacks, strokes and cardiovascular deaths in heart disease with excess weight
kidney function checked if vomiting or diarrhea is severe
boxed warning: thyroid C-cell tumors in rodents; unknown in humans
gallstones and gallbladder inflammation; gallstones in 1.6% versus 0.7% on placebo
low blood sugar is more likely with insulin or a sulfonylurea, so it's checked
digestive side effects in 74% versus 48% on placebo, such as nausea and vomiting

ask: What is our plan if I stop, given that most of the weight tends to return?
